description:
(Summary from jobright.ai; the original posting may say more.)

Premier Global Links, LLC is recruiting a Backend Software Engineer for an unnamed AI technology company. The role focuses on building and operating backend systems and infrastructure for AI agents, automated workflows, and training and evaluation datasets.
Backend Software Engineer building AI agent workflows and distributed infrastructure, data pipelines, task execution, evaluation, and dataset delivery

Responsibilities:
• Design and build reliable, long-running AI agent workflows and supporting infrastructure
• Develop and maintain backend services, distributed systems, and data pipelines
• Build systems for task execution, model evaluation, and training dataset delivery
• Improve production reliability, performance, resource utilization, and failure recovery
• Investigate complex technical issues across codebases, services, and background workflows
• Develop tools that help domain experts create, review, and evaluate AI-generated tasks
• Collaborate with engineers, domain experts, and project leads to automate manual processes
• Take ownership of features from design and implementation through deployment and ongoing operation

Requirements:
• Strong software engineering fundamentals; 0–6 years of relevant experience is welcome
• Experience building and maintaining production software, including distributed systems, backend services, data pipelines, or performance-critical applications
• Ability to take a project from initial requirements through implementation, release, and production support
• Strong debugging, problem-solving, and technical decision-making skills
• Ability to investigate unfamiliar systems and work independently in a fast-moving environment
• Interest in AI agents, model inference, evaluation systems, and reliable AI applications

Preferred:
• Experience with AI agent workflows, LLM evaluation, synthetic data, or model inference
• Experience building automation systems or large-scale data processing infrastructure
• Background at an early-stage AI startup or a company building advanced AI products
• Familiarity with distributed evaluation infrastructure and long-running background jobs
• Experience using AI-assisted development tools such as Claude Code
• Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field; strong practical engineering ability is also valued
